text:
Alyssa Parks: Quick sync — VoltCloud needs a spec for cost modeling. We want hourly slot-level exports if possible (else daily + 15m samples). Needed fields: slot_id, region, zone, timestamp_iso, gpu_type, reserved_tier_months, price_reserved_usd_per_gpu_hour, price_spot_usd_per_gpu_hour, historical_spot_hours, historical_eviction_count, eviction_prob_forecast, replacement_lead_minutes, slot_count_in_bucket, listing_fee_usd, rack_pass_through_usd, billing_proration_model, invoice_line_example.

Chris Kovacs: Finance also wants to know: how reserve credits are computed (pro-rata on committed vs used hours?), when credits apply (immediate vs monthly true-up), and how blended usage is shown on invoices (aggregate SKU lines vs per-slot).

Jun Park: Add request for eviction distribution (median + p95 lead time) by region and any SLA statements (p99 eviction-free window or events per 1k hours). Also request realized_eviction_count for historical window (last 30d) and total_spot_hours.

Priya Nair: Please ask them to include billing_proration_model values (e.g., hourly, partial_hour_round_up) and an invoice JSON example plus a human-readable line. If workloads span reserved+spot, we need example of credit allocation and blended $/GPU-hr calc.

partner-bot: Suggested minimal CSV sample row ->
slot-123,us-east-1a,A,2026-03-23T14:00:00Z,A100-80GB,12,2.40,0.78,320,1,0.003,60,8,0.10,12.50,hourly,"Usage: $256.32; Reserve credit: -$120.00; Marketplace fee: $0.80; Net: $137.12"

Alyssa Parks: Great. Two asks before we close: 1) full hourly CSV for last 30 days (or daily with 15m samples) uploaded to SFTP or shared drive; 2) a short doc paragraph (or pseudocode) showing reserve_credit calculation and timing. Also ask if marketplace listing takes are shown as % or per-line fee and whether invoice numbers are tax-inclusive.

Chris Kovacs: I'll escalate to VoltCloud lead and open a ticket. cc @partner-bot create ticket PC-4951.

partner-bot: Ticket PC-4951 created: "VoltCloud cost export + reserve crediting + invoice format". Owner: partner-ops. ETA 72h.

Alyssa Parks: Thanks — keep us posted. :white_check_mark:
